statement: Pre-flight setup is correct: board alignment yaw 45, motor order and directions, angle mode on a switch
note: Betaflight Configurator, props OFF: Motors tab - spin each motor and check position and direction against the build guide; Setup tab - tilt the quad and check the model follows (board alignment yaw = 45). Pass: all four correct.
rationale: A wrong board alignment flips the quad on its first takeoff; this is the most common first-flight failure.
